split_policy: Publisher val reserved as test; remove training source-photo/pixel overlaps with test; split remaining train by source-photo ID into train/val; remove pixel overlap with val. Exclude augmentation-suffixed files.
image_processing: RGB PNG resized to 96x96 for small demo upload
group_definition: Filename date and DJI image identifier before _cadeia_isolador_vidro_
limitations: Source-photo IDs checked; independence of adjacent flight frames, physical assets and capture sessions is not verified. Small demo, not deployment accuracy. Publisher val is repurposed as held-out test; not the original benchmark protocol.
